articles.summary: WALTHAM, Mass., Aug. 26, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - Repligen Corporation (NASDAQ:RGEN), a life sciences company focused on bioprocessing technology leadership, today announced that it will participate in the Wells Fargo 21st Annual Healthcare Conference in Boston, MA. Olivier Loeillot, President and Chief Executive Officer and Jason Garland, Chief Financial Officer, will participate in an analyst-led discussion on September 9 th at 1:30 p.m. ET. A live webcast of the conference presentation will be accessible through Repligen’s Investor Relations website at www.repligen.com , and will be available for replay for a limited period of time following the event. About Repligen Corporation Repligen Corporation is a global life sciences company that develops and commercializes highly innovative bioprocessing technologies and systems that enable efficiencies in the process of manufacturing biological drugs.
